summary: Similarweb Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that its Board appointed Michael Akkerman as Chief Executive Officer effective November 2, 2026, succeeding founder Or Offer, whose planned departure was announced in May 2026 after nearly two decades leading the company. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation were stated; the change reflects a completed, pre-announced CEO succession following a thorough and disciplined search. Akkerman joins from Digital Turbine and will lead from New York; Offer remains through a transition period. Watch execution risk, strategy continuity and any subsequent guidance reset around the November 2 handover.
